column4: Is there a current inventory of in-scope assets, owners, criticality, and dependencies?
Are administrative access and privileged identities approved, protected, and periodically reviewed?
Are network boundaries and remote/vendor access documented and appropriately restricted?
Are vulnerabilities, patches, configuration changes, backups, and recovery tested and tracked?
Are critical hospitality services covered by incident response and continuity plans?
Are guest-facing applications and APIs inventoried, owned, and subject to secure development practices?
Are authentication, authorization, session handling, and account recovery appropriate to risk?
Are dependencies, secrets, releases, and security defects managed through defined processes?
Are payment, booking, loyalty, and third-party integrations protected and monitored?
Are personal-data purposes, categories, systems, owners, and flows documented?
Are notices, rights handling, retention, deletion, and minimization implemented?
Are processors, international transfers, and third-party disclosures governed?
Are privacy incidents identified, assessed, escalated, and handled under applicable requirements?
Is there an inventory of AI-enabled features, providers, purposes, versions, and accountable owners?
